name: Sika Confibre 19F
paste:
SIKA® CONFIBRE® 19F: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Confibre® 19F, April 2023, Version 01.05 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika_confibre_19f.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Confibre® 19F where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.05).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Confibre® 19F is a fibrillated polypropylene fibre for use in concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Confibre® 19F; Is used in concrete to increase the strain capacity of the fresh concrete, thereby, reducing the incidence of plastic shrinkage cracking. Is typically used in concrete for the following applications:
    - Floor slabs
    - Driveways
    - Tilt slabs
    - Floor toppings
    - Precast elements
    - Coloured concrete
    - Pools
    - Channels
    - Retaining walls
    - Building restoration
    Can be used in both dry and wet shotcrete applications for:
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Confibre® 19F
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Fibrillated Polypropylene Fibre
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Complies with ASTM C1116/ C1116M, Type III fiber reinforced concrete and therefore ASTM D7508. Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Class 1b .
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 14889-2:2006: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ASTM C1116: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ASTM D7508: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Confibre® 19F provides the following benefits:
    - Increased resistance to plastic shrinkage cracking
    - Increased impact resistance
    - Increased abrasion resistance
    - Increased cohesion
    - Non staining
    - Reduced rebound
    - Thicker layer builds
    - Reduced sag
    - Increased fatigue resistance
    - Alkali and dust proof
    - Non staining
    When used in shotcrete the benefits are:
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 100% Virgin Fibrillated Polypropylene Fibres
    - Density: 0.91 kg/l
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: Length 19 mm - equivalent diameter 100μm
    - Melting point: 160°C
    - Ignition temperature: Above 350°C
    - Water absorption: Nil
    - Modulus of elasticity in tension: >3.500 MPa
    - Tensile strain at break: 17%
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 900g bags (15 bags per box)
    - Shelf life: Indefinite period
    - Storage conditions: The unopened boxes can be stored for indefinite period in a dry environment, protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.05) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.05) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Concrete mixing time: Place the bag directly into the ready mixed truck or central mixer. Mix for a minimum of three (3) minutes or until fibres are evenly distributed through concrete.
4.3 Recommended dosage. The recommended minimum dose rate of Sika® Confibre® 19F is 0.9kg (1 bag) per cubic metre of concrete. Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The addition of Sika® Confibre® 19F to a concrete mix is no substitute for proper curing practices.
    - Sika® Confibre® 19F is not a structural fibre and therefore should not be used as a substitute for structural steel or steel fibres in structural applications.
    - Concrete fibres in general can exhibit lower slumps and the use of a super plasticiser such as Sikament and ViscoCrete is recommended.
4.5 Further information. Low thermal and electrical conductivity.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.05) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Confibre® 19F, April 2023, Version 01.05, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika_confibre_19f.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Polypropylene-based micro fibres, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/epd-polypropylene-basedmicrofibres.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaÂ® Confibre 19F, https://aus.sika.com/dam/dms/au01/w/sds-sika-confibre19f.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
